prompt:

S040: The Coagulant Dosing Skid is placed under closer observation when intake turbidity changes faster than the normal control response can stabilize.
S041: The North Filter Gallery and South Filter Gallery are advised when incoming water quality is expected to shorten filter run time or increase solids loading.
S075: When filter capacity is reduced, the Distribution Dispatcher is advised of expected production limits before changes affect the High Service Pump Header.
S076: After any significant deviation, the Chief Operator reviews trends from the affected operating period and confirms that corrective actions restored stable clarified and filtered water quality.

Answer "supported" only if the sentences state that Chief Operator produces or sends this item AND that South Filter Gallery receives or uses the same item (it may be named more briefly in one sentence). Answer "unsupported" if they describe different items, the wrong elements or the opposite direction. Answer "uncertain" if the text is not clear enough. Return JSON {"verdict": ..., "reason": "one sentence"}.
response: {"verdict":"unsupported","reason":"S076 says the Chief Operator reviews trends and confirms that corrective actions restored stable water quality, but no sentence says this confirmation is sent to or used by the South Filter Gallery."}
